turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you order the new mechanical keyboard switches yet?
I haven't yet, Alan. I was waiting for you to confirm the color preference. Black or white?
White this time. Oh, also, quick question about our evaluation pipeline. Why are we using DMR for the latest run?
We are using it because it's a standard benchmark established by the MemGPT team.
Ah, right. I forgot they released that one. Thanks for the reminder.
No problem. Shall I go ahead with the white switches?
Yes, please. And can you check if the weather looks good for hiking on Saturday?
I'll check the forecast for Saturday now.
